newsitem.title: ITALY: Minimum rate 7.41 pct at Italy lira repo tender.
newsitem.headline: Minimum rate 7.41 pct at Italy lira repo tender.

text.p: The minimum rate at today's 11.0 trillion lire 4-day Bank of Italy repurchase tender was 7.41 percent, compared with 7.34 percent at the previous repo tender on March 26, the Bank said.
The average rate was 7.42 percent against 7.37 percent at the last repurchase pact for 11.0 trillion lire and 16 days.
The pact covers purchases today and the securities are for resale on April 15. The Bank said it received 37 bids of which four were met in full and six in part.
